Footer.freeTool: A free tool for rodent lovers

Welcome.heroSubtitle: care for the health of your little heroes
Welcome.heroDescription: With our tool you can easily log vet visits, monitor weight changes and keep all the important information in one place. Capture special moments by adding photos of your companions.
Welcome.featureVetDescription: Track your rodents' vet visit history with ease and precision
Welcome.featureWeightDescription: Visualize weight changes over time with weight history and a chart
Welcome.featureGalleryDescription: Add the cutest photos of your companion and revisit the memories.
Welcome.featureSharingDescription: Share data with the people closest to you
Welcome.featureExportDescription: Export all the collected data at any time
Welcome.featureFreeDescription: The service is completely free, ad-free and built according to current security standards
Welcome.showcaseSimpleDescription: Track the health history of your mice – from vet visits, through weight changes, to notes. Everything you need, available in one place.
Welcome.showcaseMemoriesDescription: Keep the most beautiful moments with your companions. Add photos and build a digital album of memories.
Welcome.showcaseSecureDescription: Our service is completely free, ad-free, and data export gives you full control over the information about your pets.
Welcome.finalCtaText: Join our community and take care of the health of your little heroes today!
